title: PageAnnotation
description: Schema defining collaborative annotations for a single page of Finnegans Wake using standard academic pagination (pages 1 through 628).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the annotation schema.

work.description: Unique identifier of the literary work (e.g. 'finnegans-wake', 'ulysses').

book.description: Book number or major division identifier.

chapter.description: Chapter number within the respective book.

part.description: Part number or major division in works structured into parts.

episode.description: Episode number in works structured into episodes.

annotations.description: List of line-level or phrase-level annotations on this page.

id.description: Unique annotation identifier incorporating page.line and short hash/token, e.g. 001.01-a1b2.

line_number.description: Line number on the page (typically 1 through 40, max 60).

target_phrase.description: Short target lemma, motif, or phrase anchor (strictly minimal for identification; no reproduction of copyrighted passages).

annotation_text.description: Critical analysis, motif breakdown, linguistic etymology, or literary gloss.

categories.description: Thematic or analytical tags (e.g., etymology, motif, music, folklore, Dublin topography, front-matter).

cross_references.description: Other page and line occurrences in standard notation (e.g., ['004.18', '628.16']).

sources.description: Scholarly source citations or references supporting the note.

contributors.description: GitHub usernames or contributor identifiers responsible for this note.

work.description: Optional work identifier for the annotation (e.g. 'finnegans-wake', 'ulysses').
